description: This file is a shell script containing tests for git clone operations, including various cloning scenarios such as local clone, clone with bundles, handling non-existent branches, shallow clones, and permission-related cloning tests. It uses functions, environment variables, and external commands to verify git functionalities.

methods.name: repo_is_hardlinked
methods.description: Checks if the repository at given path uses hard links for its objects directory by finding files with a single link.
